scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run start:dev --workspace backend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.test:web: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e --workspace frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
